definitions.gloss: aspect; appearance; state of affairs; look
definitions.explanation: The outward appearance or general condition of a situation, often used when describing how things look or what state they are in. Frequently used in news and formal writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{様相|ようそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一変|いっぺん}→一変：11203_ippen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な{様相|ようそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呈|てい}している→呈する：12003_teisuru⟧。
examples.english: The situation is taking on a serious aspect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悲惨|ひさん}→悲惨：12633_hisan⟧な{様相|ようそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呈|てい}していた→呈する：12003_teisuru⟧。
examples.english: After the typhoon passed, the disaster area presented a tragic scene.

notes:
A somewhat formal word used to describe the overall look or condition of a situation. Common in news reporting, formal writing, and literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {様相|ようそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呈|てい}する→呈する：12003_teisuru⟧: to present an appearance; to take on an aspect (set phrase)
- {様相|ようそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一変|いっぺん}→一変：11203_ippen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the situation changes completely
- ⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧な{様相|ようそう}: a new aspect
- ⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧{様相|ようそう}: a different aspect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧: appearance, state — more conversational and everyday; used for people and situations
- ⟦{局面|きょくめん}→局面：05777_kyokumen⟧: phase, aspect — emphasizes a stage or turning point in a developing situation
- ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧: situation, circumstances — more neutral and factual; broader in application
